verdict.rationale: Lovable has no dedicated analytics or insights feature, but its chat can work with your data. It can query the project database read-only (via the Telegram bot), answer questions about workspace apps (in Slack), and pull live context from CRMs, knowledge bases and ClickHouse through chat connectors. Getting insights depends on you prompting it. missing for 10: a documented in-product feature that generates insights or suggestions from data, proactive or automatic recommendations, examples of insight output, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
